headline: Olongapo Hospital Reaches Full Bed Capacity Amid Leptospirosis Surge
seoTitle: Olongapo Hospital Hits Full Capacity Amid Leptospirosis Cases | FMB News
seoDescription: James L. Gordon Memorial Hospital in Olongapo City has reached full bed capacity as patients, including suspected and confirmed leptospirosis cases, continue to arrive after flooding.
keywords: James L Gordon Memorial Hospital leptospirosis
deck: James L. Gordon Memorial Hospital says its emergency room remains open for triage, but inpatient admissions may face delays and some patients may be referred to other facilities.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: James L. Gordon Memorial Hospital in Olongapo City has reached full inpatient bed capacity amid a continuing rise in patients, including suspected and confirmed leptospirosis cases.

The hospital said its emergency room remains open and patients will continue to undergo triage and medical assessment, but those who need admission may experience delays while beds are fully occupied.

sections.heading: Referral arrangements
paragraphs: When necessary, the hospital will coordinate referrals to other appropriate health facilities based on a patient's condition and the level of care required.
Pediatric patients who may require dialysis, particularly children weighing less than 30 kilograms, will be assessed individually and referred when higher or more specialized care is needed.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: Flood exposure raises the risk of leptospirosis, a bacterial infection associated with water contaminated by the urine of infected animals. Recent monsoon flooding in Olongapo and neighboring areas has increased demand for medical care.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: A full-capacity public hospital can create admission delays and increase pressure on surrounding facilities, making clear referral pathways and appropriate use of emergency versus outpatient services especially important during a post-flood disease surge.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Residents should follow advisories from local health authorities and the hospital on referral arrangements, prevention measures and any further changes in capacity.
